# bizkit_form (Resource)

A form that collects submissions from a site. Sites post to `endpoint`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "bizkit_form" "contact" {
  project_id    = bizkit_project.website.id
  name          = "Contact"
  notify_emails = ["team@example.com"]
  redirect_url  = "https://example.com/thanks"
  fields = [
    { name = "email", kind = "email", required = true },
    { name = "message", label = "Message", kind = "text", required = true },
    { name = "topic", kind = "choice", options = ["sales", "support"] },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The display name.
- `project_id` (String) The project the form belongs to. Changing it replaces the form.

### Optional

- `bot_check` (String) `honeypot` or `challenge` (ALTCHA proof of work). Defaults to `honeypot`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Disabled forms answer 404 to submissions. Defaults to `true`.
- `fields` (Attributes List) The accepted fields. Empty keeps every field a site sends. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fields))
- `min_fill_ms` (Number) Submissions faster than this after the page loads count as spam. Defaults to 2000.
- `notify_emails` (Set of String) Addresses mailed on each new submission, in lower case.
- `redirect_url` (String) Where browsers go after a plain HTML post.

### Read-Only

- `challenge_url` (String) The URL the ALTCHA widget loads challenges from.
- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339).
- `endpoint` (String) The URL sites post to.
- `id` (String) The form ID.

<a id="nestedatt--fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fields`

Required:

- `kind` (String) One of `text`, `email`, `url`, `number`, `choice`.
- `name` (String) The input's `name`, unique in the form.

Optional:

- `label` (String) A label for the UI and mail; the name when unset.
- `max_length` (Number) The longest value, 1-10000 characters.
- `multiple` (Boolean) A `choice` field takes several values.
- `options` (List of String) The allowed values of a `choice` field.
- `required` (Boolean) A non-blank value is needed. Defaults to `false`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by ID.
tofu import bizkit_form.example <id>
```
